Uses of Package
io.mavlink4j.session

Packages that use io.mavlink4j.session
Package
Description
io.mavlink4j.service
L4 — one class per MAVLink microservice (command, parameter, heartbeat, manual control, message interval, capability).
io.mavlink4j.session
L3 — the MavlinkSession composition root: reader threads, peer directory, dispatcher, correlator, TX scheduler.
io.mavlink4j.testkit
Test doubles for code that talks MAVLink through mavlink4j, with no SITL, socket or hardware needed: a scripted FakeVehicle, in-memory links (RecordingLink, LoopbackLinkPair) and deterministic time (ManualInstantSource, DirectTxScheduler).
  • Classes in io.mavlink4j.session used by io.mavlink4j.service
    Class
    Description
    Correlator
    The join between MAVLink's outbound request path and its unsolicited-inbound reply path: a pending-request registry that completes a future when a matching reply is decoded.
    MatchKey
    The key a Correlator waiter is registered and matched under.
    PeerDirectory
    Who is out there — read-only protocol facts, updated by MavlinkSession as frames arrive.
    TxScheduler
    Runs named periodic TX tasks (heartbeat emission, RC override relay, ...) on one shared thread pool rather than one hand-rolled thread loop per feature, so every periodic sender shares one thread lifecycle.

    Class
    Description
    AsyncSubscription
    A live Dispatcher.subscribeAsync(io.mavlink4j.session.MessageFilter, java.util.function.Consumer<io.mavlink4j.codec.Frame>) registration: closing it stops delivery and shuts the subscriber's own drain thread down.
    Correlator
    The join between MAVLink's outbound request path and its unsolicited-inbound reply path: a pending-request registry that completes a future when a matching reply is decoded.
    Dispatcher
    Fan-out of decoded frames to subscribers, filtered by MessageFilter.
    HeartbeatInfo
    The facts a HEARTBEAT message carries about a peer's firmware and current mode, decoded but not interpreted — no firmware-name lookup, no "is this ArduCopter or PX4" labelling.
    LinkHealth
    Per-peer link quality, tracked from observed seq accounting (the spec defines no drop-rate formula — see DefaultLinkHealth for ours, documented as ours, not standard).
    LinkHealth.Health
     
    LinkQuality
    Per-link radio-quality telemetry, keyed by LinkId rather than PeerId — a deliberate, separate port from LinkHealth: LinkHealth.Health already collapses to "whichever link this peer was most recently heard on," and folding a per-link RSSI field into it would either go stale the moment a peer is heard on a second link, or force a host's status provider to reason about a dimension it doesn't need.
    LinkQuality.Quality
    One RADIO_STATUS (#109) snapshot.
    MatchKey
    The key a Correlator waiter is registered and matched under.
    MessageFilter
    A predicate a Dispatcher subscription tests every decoded frame against.
    Peer
    One MAVLink peer this session has observed traffic from — protocol facts only, latest-wins.
    PeerDirectory
